resources.string: No system voice is available on this device
Turn it on in Settings to dictate
The selected dictation engine is unavailable. Using system dictation.
Speech recognition isn\'t available on this device. Choose a cloud dictation engine in the app\'s voice settings.
Can\'t use the microphone right now

Dictation and read aloud use your device\'s built-in voice for free. For better accuracy or a more natural voice, switch to a provider you\'ve connected. Realtime voice talks to your provider\'s model directly and is billed to your account with that provider.
Recordings are sent only to the provider you choose. If transcription fails, the recording stays on this device for up to 7 days. Voice conversations listen with this engine too.

System dictation is handled by this device\'s speech recognition service, which may go through Google or your device manufacturer. If transcription fails, the saved recording stays on this device for up to 7 days. Voice conversations listen with this engine too.
Cloud engines can\'t be loaded right now

For a more natural voice, download voice data in your system\'s text-to-speech settings.
Read aloud skips thinking and code. If the cloud voice is unavailable, the system voice takes over. Voice conversations speak with this voice and speed too.

Your recordings will be sent to %1$s to be transcribed. Oriveo doesn\'t keep them, and the provider\'s privacy policy applies.
Replies you play will be sent as text to %1$s to generate speech. Oriveo doesn\'t keep them, and the provider\'s privacy policy applies.

Your voice and this chat\'s history are sent directly to %1$s, and %1$s\'s privacy policy applies. Realtime voice is billed by audio length and usually costs more than text chats; charges go to your %1$s account.
